# Naowh Forever

**Naowh's companion addon for World of Warcraft Forever**

Your BiS list, a dungeon journal, professions, a training planner, gear swaps
and a lot of quality of life, all in one window.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join-5865f2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white&labelColor=0b1a24)](https://discord.gg/naowh)
[![naowh.gg](https://img.shields.io/badge/naowh.gg-Website-c8a46a?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0b1a24)](https://naowh.gg/)
[![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Releases-36c5d8?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white&labelColor=0b1a24)](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/releases)
[![WoW Forever](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW-Forever-1f7fe0?style=for-the-badge&logo=battledotnet&logoColor=white&labelColor=0b1a24)](https://www.wowhead.com/forever)

[Install](#install)  |  [What's inside](#whats-inside)  |  [Commands](#commands)  |  [Changelog](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)  |  [Contributing](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)

---

## What's inside

| Module | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **BiS List** | Your best-in-slot list in its own window: your gear on a paperdoll, every pick per slot ranked with stars, where each drops and where to run next. Marked on tooltips and called out when it drops. Open it with its own key too. |
| **Stat Weights** | What each stat is worth to your spec, with your own changes: a line on gear tooltips ("Fire: +9% upgrade" and what it is weighed against), and the BiS List's upgrades and enchants. On BiS List's Stat Weights tab. |
| **Dungeon Journal** | Every dungeon on Forever, the new ones included, and the raids: its bosses in order and what they drop, your BiS marked, your quests there with what to do first, a tip from Naowh for each boss and how many times you have killed it. A map of each classic dungeon with every boss on it, and in a dungeon the world map (M) shows it, with the Journal beside it. Open it with its own key too. |
| **Discovery** | Library books to find around Azeroth and who to hand them to, the Cozy Sleeping Bag's chain step by step, the quest chain for each dungeon key and attunement, Molten Core's included, and your class's own quest chains. Its Quest List tab has every quest of every zone for your character, your progress per zone, and every quest chain with the step you are on; its Rares tab every rare of every zone on the map, with an alert when you see one. Open the Quest List with `/nfquests`. |
| **Training Planner** | What you can train now, what each level brings and what it costs, with the way to your nearest trainer. |
| **Professions** | Recipes, reagents and crafting in one window, including the recipes you have not learned yet. |
| **The Market** | A panel beside Blizzard's auction house: your bags most valuable first, each priced a step under the live listings and posted with a click, and your undercut auctions cancelled one press at a time. Its own window has Farm, Reagents and every item's price over two weeks. |
| **Gear & Trinkets** | Swap equipment sets from a bar, or automatically while you ride or rest. |
| **Blessings** | Paladin blessings by class and player, shared with your group's paladins. |
| **Macros** | Class, consumable and focus macros, written and kept up to date for you. |
| **Action Bars** | Your action bars saved by name and put back whenever you want them. |
| **Buffs & Reminders** | Buff, consumable and campfire reminders, and a low health warning. |
| **Threat Meter** | Threat on your target for the whole group, and a warning before you pull. |
| **Group Inspect** | Everyone in your party or raid in one window: their Gear Score, item level, gear, talents and stats, and who runs Naowh Forever. |
| **PvP** | What your target is doing in a fight: their short buffs and the crowd control on them, and battleground displays. |
| **Swing Timer** | Your swings from the game's own timer, with marks for timing around them. |
| **Druid Mana** | A druid's mana while shapeshifted, with the five second rule, the cost of shifting back and how many shifts you have left. |
| **Raid Debuffs** | The raid debuffs you pick on your target, Sunder Armor to the warlock curses, with the missing ones easy to spot, in combat too. |
| **Quality of Life** | Questing, loot and bag space, alerts, casting, tooltips, trainer ranks, flight and camp, mail and more, and the Top Bar: friends, guild, the clock and your addon buttons across the top of the screen. |
| **Supporter Badges** | The Naowh Forever N next to the name of Naowh, the devs, the mods and our Legendary and Epic patrons. See [Supporter badges](#supporter-badges). |

> [!TIP]
> Every module starts **off**. Turn on only what you want; anything you leave off costs
> nothing, not even a registered event. Supporter badges are the exception: they start on so
> everyone sees them, and each part can be turned off.

Settings live in **Profiles**, so you can switch between them, copy them to another
character or share them with a friend.

## Install

1. Download the newest `NaowhForever-<version>.zip` from
   [Releases](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/releases).
2. Extract it into your Forever `Interface\AddOns` folder, so that you end up with
   `Interface\AddOns\NaowhForever\NaowhForever.toc` and each module's
   `Interface\AddOns\NaowhForever_<Module>` folder beside it.
3. Log in, or type `/reload` if you are already in game, then open it with `/nf`.

## Commands

| Command | Opens |
| --- | --- |
| `/nf` | The main window (also `/naowh` and `/nao`) |
| `/nfbis` | Your BiS list |
| `/nfjournal` | Dungeon Journal (also `/nfdj`) |
| `/nfquests` | Quest List: your quests and rares per zone, and quest chains (`/nfcompleto` too) |
| `/nfdiscovery` | Discovery |
| `/nftraining` | Training Planner |
| `/nfgear` | Gear Sets |
| `/nfbless` | Blessings |
| `/nfmacros` | Macros |
| `/nfbars` | Action Bars |
| `/nf ab <name>` | Imports a saved action bar set; `/nf ab` alone lists them |
| `/nfbuffs` | Buffs & Reminders |
| `/nfthreat` | Threat Meter |
| `/nfgroup` | Group Inspect (also `/nf group`) |
| `/nfpvp` | PvP |
| `/nf setup` | The onboarding, to pick your profile, skin and modules again |
| `/nf quiz` | A WoW quiz for flights and campfires |
| `/nfaim` | The Aim Trainer |
| `/nf junk` | Your Junk List (Junk Marker, QoL > Loot & Items); `/nf scrap` still works |
| `/nf shopping` | Your Shopping List window (Professions > Shopping List) |
| `/copy` | The text under your mouse, ready to copy (turn on Global Copy in QoL > Interface) |
| `/nf badges id` | Your badge code, for all your characters (see [Supporter badges](#supporter-badges)) |

You can also open the window from the addon compartment next to the minimap.

## Supporter badges

Naowh, the developers, the moderators and the Legendary and Epic patrons on Naowh's Patreon get the
Naowh Forever N next to their name in chat. Hover the name for their card. If you turn it
on, a banner also shows when they join your group.

Everyone with Naowh Forever sees them. You can turn each part off in **QoL > Interface >
Supporter Badges**: chat badges, the hover card and the tooltip line start on, the group
banner starts off, and there's an option to skip the banner for your own guild.

| Badge | Who |
| --- | --- |
| Naowh, the Floorpov (gold) | Naowh |
| Developer (blue) | The people building Naowh Forever |
| Moderator (red) | The people keeping the community running |
| Staff Member (rainbow) | The rest of the team behind Naowh |
| Legendary Patron (orange) | Legendary tier on Naowh's Patreon |
| Epic Patron (purple) | Epic tier on Naowh's Patreon |

### Getting your badge

The badge is tied to your characters, not your name, so we need their IDs. You only do this
once.

1. Log into every character you want the badge on, once. The addon remembers them.
2. Type `/nf badges id`. A box opens with one code for all of them, like
   `90:Player-4613-006EB819,Player-4613-00ABCDEF`.
3. Press **Ctrl+C** to copy it.
4. Send it:
   - **Legendary and Epic patrons:** send it in a support request on
     [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/naowh) to be added.
   - **Developers, moderators and staff:** send it to Glyalith.

Your badge shows up with the next release. Made a new alt? Log into it, run `/nf badges id`
again and send the new code.

**Don't have the addon yet?** This line prints the same code for the character you're on:

```
/run print(GetCurrentRegion()..":"..UnitGUID("player"))
```

Run it on each character. To send several at once, keep the number before the `:` once and
join the rest with commas: `90:Player-4613-006EB819,Player-4613-00ABCDEF`. The first time,
the game may ask you to allow scripts.

The code only has your region and your characters' IDs. No names, nothing else.

### Adding staff (maintainers)

Staff are in `Core/Badges/Staff.lua`, by region and then character ID. The
number before the `:` in the code is the region. Forever has its own region numbers, not
retail's 1 to 5, so always copy it from the code. For `90:Player-4613-006EB819`:

```lua
[90] = {
    ["Player-4613-006EB819"] = { tier = "developer", title = "Lead Developer" },
},
```

Tiers are `naowh`, `developer`, `moderator` and `staff`; `title` is optional. Add one line per
character in the code. Don't edit `Core/Badges/Patrons.lua`: the patron sync
writes it. Staff can check a badge with
`/nf badges preview [naowh|developer|moderator|staff|legendary|epic]` and `/nf badges toast`.

## Contributing

Bug fixes and ideas are welcome. Read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
before you start: it has the rules every change is reviewed against, how to set up the
checks, and how commits and pull requests are named. All UI is built from the shared
components in [`Shared/`](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/blob/main/Shared/README.md): use them, extend them, or add a new one there,
never a copy inside a module. For anything bigger than a fix,
message Glyalith on [Discord](https://discord.gg/naowh) first.

By submitting a contribution you confirm it is your own work, or that you have the right
to submit it, and you take responsibility for it: nothing may be copied from another
addon, site or tool against its license or terms. See
[Your responsibility for what you submit](https://github.com/naowh-gaming/NaowhForever/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-responsibility-for-what-you-submit).

## Releasing a new version

For maintainers. A release is one click:

1. Check that everything for the release is merged into `main`. On an up-to-date `main`,
   `GH_REPO=naowh-gaming/NaowhForever python Tools/release/release.py pending` (needs `gh`) prints
   `## Unreleased` as the release will write it, with the `## Changelog` lines from the
   merged PRs' descriptions; fix a line by editing that PR's description.
2. Open **Actions > Release > Run workflow** and keep the branch on `main`.
3. Pick the **Bump** and click **Run workflow**:

   | Bump | From `1.0.6` |
   | --- | --- |
   | patch (default) | `1.0.7` |
   | minor | `1.1.0` |
   | major | `2.0.0` |

   **Version** takes an exact version instead, for anything the bumps can't express.

The workflow then:

- adds the merged PRs' changelog lines to `## Unreleased` and renames it to the version,
  sets every TOC's `## Version` (the core's and each module addon's) and `ns.CODE_BUILD`,
  and pushes that as `chore(release): <version>` to `main`;
- tags the commit, and the tag starts a second Release run that builds the zip,
  publishes the GitHub release with the player notes and every commit since the last
  tag, uploads to CurseForge and Wago, and posts the notes to Discord;
- puts an empty `## Unreleased` back at the top of the changelog on `main`.

The push uses the `RELEASE_DEPLOY_KEY` secret: a deploy key with write access, on Protect
main's bypass list. Without it, `main` rejects the release commit and nothing is published.

It stops before changing anything if there is nothing for `## Unreleased`, it is not the
newest section, a merged PR's changelog line does not start with `Added:`, `Changed:` or
`Fixed:` (the error names the PR), the tag already exists, or the version is not like
`1.0.7`. Pushing a tag by hand still releases, but only with what `CHANGELOG.md`
already says: the PRs' lines are added by the workflow.

### On a schedule

- **Every day at 15:30 UTC**, after the US realms' daily reset, the same release runs by itself,
  as a patch. On a day with nothing for players since the last release, its one changelog line
  is the day's Daily Word (`Changed: Daily Word #N is out`). A release whose notes are only that
  line uploads to CurseForge and GitHub but posts nothing to Discord or the website; a day with
  changes for players releases them as usual, with the Discord post.
- **Every night at 22:00 UTC** a beta: main's version is stamped on a commit of its own and
  tagged `<next>-beta.<n>` (after `1.0.6`: `1.0.7-beta.1`, `1.0.7-beta.2`, ...). That commit is
  never pushed to `main`. CurseForge publishes it on the beta channel, and the GitHub release's
  notes are `## Unreleased` as `pending` prints it. Betas post nothing to Discord, and a night
  with nothing new on `main` since the last release or beta tags nothing.
- **Run workflow** with **beta** ticked tags tonight's beta at once.
- **At 20:30 UTC** a price release: the newest release again, tagged
  `<release>-prices.<n>` (after `1.0.6`: `1.0.6-prices.1`, `1.0.6-prices.2`, ...) on an empty
  commit of its own on top of the release, not `main`, so nothing merged since goes out with it. Every tagged
  release builds the auction prices of its hour before packaging (`NaowhForever_AuctionData`,
  from Blizzard's auction data with the repository's `BLIZZARD_CLIENT_ID` and
  `BLIZZARD_CLIENT_SECRET`), so the release channel gets new prices at 15:30 and 20:30, and the
  beta channel at 22:00. It runs only between the daily release and the beta: CurseForge's beta
  channel takes whichever file is newest, so a price release after a beta would take beta players
  back to the release, and none goes out while a beta of a later version is out (a daily release
  that failed). A price release goes to CurseForge only: on GitHub it would become the latest
  release, which the desktop app and naowh.gg install and show. It adds no changelog line, so it
  posts nothing to Discord or the website. It tags nothing if Blizzard sends no prices; a daily
  release or beta that gets none ships the newest release's, with a warning.
- **Run workflow** with **prices** ticked makes a price release at once.

Betas and price releases never move the release's number: the next release counts from the
newest version without a suffix.

releases.notes:
## What's new

### Added
- Market Farm: click a herb, vein or skinning camp on the zone's map to loop only the spots that
  give its item; click it again to loop everything.
- The Market: the Buy tab's Upgrades view sorts by required level as well as by gain; click Level or
  Gain beside its price box. Each row shows the piece's required level.
- Map & Pins: PvP Quests, turn it off to keep Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin and Alterac Valley quest
  givers off the map and minimap.
- Loot Rolls is back: a small window of the group's rolls showing who picked Need, Greed or Pass,
  their roll and who won. Turn it on on the Loot & Items page.
- Buff Reminders: profession cooldown tooltips show hours and minutes left, like "3h 30m".

### Changed
- Roll Bars shows the item tooltip when you hover the item name as well as the icon.
- The Market: with the Gamepad interface style on, The Market window, tooltip prices, Record Gold
  and watch alerts now work; only the parts on Blizzard's auction house, bag and mail windows stay
  off.
- Dungeon Journal: the Run Panel is now on by default. Turn it off in /nf, Dungeon Journal, Journal,
  Run Panel.
- Professions: with the Forever skin, the window wears the game's frame and art, with the
  profession's name on the title bar and its card behind the recipe.
- Professions: with the Forever skin, skill bars on the window and the overview are the game's, with
  each profession's moving fill and gryphons or wyverns.
- Professions: with the Forever skin, the recipe list, search box, number boxes and scroll bar use
  the game's art.
- Professions: with the Forever skin, the difficulty line (Skill-up Thresholds) is the game's stat
  bar, with the numbers on top and an arrow at your skill.
- Professions: the overview stays Naowh's in combat; its spell buttons work again once combat ends.

### Fixed
- Quest List: opening the world map in a dungeon no longer stutters reading your quests when no
  quest giver stands on that map.
- Journeys no longer sends walks from Orgrimmar's west road out the west gate and round to the main
  gate.
- Journeys: no error when combat starts just as a walk is being planned.
- Talent Builds, the Consumable Bar editor and BiS section headings no longer overlap when button or
  heading text is long, as in Russian.
- Journeys walks no longer go the long way round rocky ground that you can walk over, and Eastern
  Kingdoms walks between the Wetlands and Loch Modan go through Dun Algaz.
- Buff Reminders: the Weapon Enhancement Reminder offers sharpening stones only for sharp weapons
  and weightstones only for blunt ones, so a fist weapon or mace no longer gets a stone it can't
  take.
- Flight Timer: Mount Hyjal flights show the right time instead of running about 65% long.
- Flight Timer: a saved flight time far shorter than the real flight is no longer used.
- Buff Reminders: Profession Cooldown Reminders no longer say Mooncloth or a transmute is ready
  while it is still on cooldown. Open the profession once to pick up a cooldown used before the
  update.
- Blessings: the window opens again with a PallyPower paladin in your group, or another paladin's
  row you may not change, instead of erroring with its grid half drawn.
- Professions: the window no longer jumps when you start dragging it.
- Professions: if combat starts just as the overview is open, the game's overview shows instead of
  an invisible window that blocks clicks until combat ends.

## What's new

### Roll Bars

Roll Bars restyles the game's own Need, Greed and Pass popups. Turn it on on the Loot & Items page.
- Set their size, bar texture and colours, background, borders, icon, and the size and place of
  every text. A live preview shows each change: drag its edges, scroll over a part to change it, or
  click a part to jump to its setting.
- Bigger Need, Greed and Pass buttons that count who picked each, and name them when you point at
  one.
- Items on your BiS list get an orange border, a star by their name and a glow: a Flash when the
  roll appears (for 1 to 10 seconds, or always on) or Pixel Lines.
- Show Winner keeps a roll on screen once it ends, with who won it and their roll, on the left or
  right.
- Test Rolls shows three sample rolls where yours will appear; move them in the HUD Editor.
- Turn Off EllesmereUI's Popup Skin, for players who use both.
- It replaces the Loot Rolls window.

### Added
- BiS List: a PvP Gear setting (Settings, Lists card). Turn it off to leave PvP rank, battleground
  and PvP vendor gear out of the picker, Pre-raid BiS and generated lists.

### Changed
- BiS, Market and Professions: item tooltips show the comparison with your equipped item only while
  you hold Shift, like the Dungeon Journal.
- Settings previews stay on screen while you scroll through their card's settings.

## What's new

### Added
- Discovery > Library Books > Waypoints > Nearest Book points a waypoint at the nearest library book
  you still need in your zone, and at the next one once you loot it. Your own waypoints are left
  alone.
- Dungeon Journal: Blackmaw Hold's rares Sabella No-Eyes and Mopes and Shaper's Terrace's King Op,
  with their drops. Blackmaw Hold's trash adds Spearfisher's Waders and Demon Worshipper's Necklace,
  Shaper's Terrace's trash adds Pattern: Blue Dragonscale Helm, and the Avatar of Hakkar adds
  Pattern: Mender's Leather Gauntlets.
- Dungeon Journal: new class quests with their chains: Materials of Significance (Alliance paladins,
  Maraudon and Blackrock Depths), The Talisman of Kazdor (rogues, Zul'Farrak), Dreadsteed of Xoroth
  (warlocks, Dire Maul, on Lord Hel'nurath's card) and the Alliance's The Darkreaver Menace
  (shamans, Scholomance).
- Dungeon Journal: quest tips for The Coldbringer's Eye, Gahz'rilla's Mallet, Materials of
  Significance, The Talisman of Kazdor and Prospect of Faith.
- Dungeon map: Lorgus Jett's two other spawn spots in Blackfathom Deeps show as faded pins. In
  Krol'dok Stronghold, Tunk and Zalfan Moonshadow show as quest pins and Nar'gurk's pin is where he
  stands.
- Dungeon Journal > Filters > Level Range: only list the loot for the required levels you type.
  Leave a box empty for no limit.
- Dungeon Journal: a quest that needs a reputation shows it above its objectives (for example
  Requires Neutral with Timbermaw Hold), green when you have it and red when not, with your standing
  on a small bar.
- Dungeon Journal: in a quest's chain, the steps done inside a dungeon are marked with a skull and
  the dungeon's name.
- Dungeon Journal > PvP now has Warsong Gulch's Silverwing Sentinels and Warsong Outriders, and
  Alterac Valley's Stormpike Guard and Frostwolf Clan. Each page has its rewards by standing (every
  level of each), prices, its quartermaster on the map, and for Alterac Valley the insignia and Hero
  quest chains with the standing each step needs. The PvP Rank page now shows what each Mark of
  Honor buys.
- Discovery > Attunements > Class shows the whole Tier 0.5 (Dungeon Set 2) questline for your class,
  from An Earnest Proposition to Saving the Best for Last, with the step you are on, waypoints, a
  row on the Attunements tracker and a map pin.
- Settings > Colors: with the Custom theme, Background has an opacity, so the addon's windows can be
  see-through to match the rest of your UI.

### Changed
- Dungeon Journal: its data is updated to WoW Forever build 1.60.1.71091.
- Dungeon Journal: boss loot updated from the latest Forever loot lists.
- The Market: the Price Graph shows each day's median price instead of its lowest, so one cheap
  listing no longer drags a whole day down. Dropped, Rose and the tooltip's change and average
  follow it. Days already in your history keep their lowest price until they age out.
- Destroy Cheapest: the confirm click is cancelled when the stack, the item link, the loot shown or
  the button changes.
- Professions: with the Forever skin, the overview's profession cards use the game's own card art.
- Professions: the overview hides in combat and the game's own overview shows until combat ends.
- Professions: the overview cards no longer show the next-rank strip; the recipe window's rank
  banner still shows it, with its waypoint.
- Bag Space: scanning your bags after looting is faster with auction values on.
- Consumable Bar: lighter while eating, drinking and buffing.
- Dungeon Journal: "Level N to pick up" is red while you are under that level.

### Fixed
- Destroy Cheapest: All Items no longer offers quest items, keys, recipes, tools, set pieces, BiS
  items or bound gear.
- Destroy Cheapest: the fishing pole is protected like the other profession tools.
- Destroy Cheapest: the second click checks the item again, including Keep Items Worth More Than,
  and destroys nothing if it changed.
- Professions: the overview's title bar shows Shopping List, Crafting Queue, Reagents and Alts, and
  no longer keeps Disenchant or Skill-up Plan from the last recipe.
- Quest List: opening the world map, changing zone or talking to quest givers no longer stutters
  with the Quest List on.
- Auction Prices: no more hitch on the first item you hover or loot after logging in.
- Bags: looting with BiS marks, Bag Worth or Junk Marker on no longer stutters.
- Favorite Patterns no longer searches the auction house as soon as it opens, which stalled Browse
  and scans; click Scan on the panel to check live prices.
- Professions: a new character no longer starts with another character's favourite recipes, crafting
  queue or shopping list, so Favorite Patterns stops showing an alt's patterns.
- Dungeon Journal: opening the map inside a dungeon no longer redraws the dungeon map's boss pins
  each time.
- Dungeon Journal: opening the map inside a dungeon no longer redraws the page beside it after a
  group change or a wipe, and the dungeon map is ready from the loading screen.
- Dungeon Journal: Uldaman and Razorfen Downs no longer say they are not open on Forever yet.
- Dungeon Journal: Blackmaw Reclamation's chain now starts at Ekkal and needs all three of Korsa's
  quests. Quests in Blackmaw Hold, Alcaz Prison, Krol'dok Stronghold, Zul'Farrak, Maraudon and
  Razorfen Downs that had no giver now name one and get a waypoint.
- Dungeon Journal: the Horde's The Darkreaver Menace is now Forever's version, so taking it no
  longer shows the quest as lost. Nostro's Compendium shows only to warriors and paladins, and The
  Medallion of Faith says it is repeatable. Also: Uldaman and Razorfen Downs were forced closed
  ("open": false, set 15 Oct before players could enter them) and are open now;
  `test-dungeon-journal.lua` marks Razorfen Downs closed only for its closed-page check.
- Journeys: the Journey card times walks at your real speed, so mounting up or a speed buff shortens
  the journey straight away.
- Dungeon Journal: a Scholomance run now finishes without Kirtonos the Herald, who has to be
  summoned. He is listed as optional.
- Dungeon Journal and BiS List: rogues can use one-hand axes, so My Class Only, BiS picks and
  upgrades include them.
- Dungeon map: in the Stockade, Bruegal Ironknuckle's pin is in his cell instead of the room at the
  end of the corridor, and Targorr the Dread's is in his cell. The other spots each of them can
  spawn at show as faded pins.
- Discovery > Quest List: the Tier 0.5 class quests (An Earnest Proposition, Just Compensation,
  Anthion's Parting Words, Saving the Best for Last) are WoW Forever's own, at Forever's Deliana and
  Mokvar, for every class including the Horde paladin and the Alliance shaman, in place of the
  classic ones Forever no longer gives.
- Quest List and Journeys: quest givers and turn-ins in Stormwind, Mulgore, Redridge and the Eastern
  Plaguelands no longer point where the old map had them (Tirion Fordring, Nathanos Blightcaller,
  Thunder Bluff's new givers and others).
- The Market: the Ledger's name filter works again on characters whose saved sales include a vendor
  or trainer with no name recorded, so the list no longer stays unfiltered until you scroll.
- BiS List: Tier 0.5 (Dungeon Set 2) pieces name your own faction's vendor (Deliana in Ironforge for
  the Alliance) and its waypoint, and Run Next says the vendor sells them.
- BiS List: Generate BiS List no longer picks Tier 0.5 pieces before level 58, when their quests
  start.

## What's new
